name: com.usenordo/nordo
title: nordo
description: nordo is agentic commerce for any business: find and order products, food for pickup and bookings.

tools.name: search_offers
tools.description: Searches products, items for pickup, services and appointments sold by every shop on nordo. With shop, the same search and filters as that shop's page. Returns one page of matching offers with price, facts (colour, size, material…), choices, the shop's own photo and, for each option that fits the filters (or the colour or size the words name), its price, stock, item code and order link, with a count and a link for the other options; then the filters that narrow the results (with counts) and the next page. When nothing is found, notes say why. Several item codes go into one order with one payment link.

query.description: What the person wants, in their words: "waterproof hiking jacket", "bucket of wings", "haircut", "gift card". Empty with filters lists everything that fits them.

kind.description: product: shipped to an address. pickup: collected at the shop at a chosen time (meals, coffee, cakes, flowers). booking: an appointment, a class or a restaurant table, at a time. simple: nothing to ship or collect (gift cards, tickets).

max_price.description: Highest price in the shop's currency, e.g. 150 for 150.00.

ship_to.description: Products only: ISO country code they must ship to, e.g. "DE". Across every shop only.

shop.description: Only this shop (its address, e.g. "acme"): its own search, with the filters below.

category.description: With shop: one of the shop's categories (get_shop lists them), or several separated by commas.

filters.description: With shop: the shop's filters by their param (get_shop catalog.filters, or the filters in a search answer), values from that filter: {"color": ["black", "olive"], "size": ["m"]}. Values of one filter are alternatives; filters combine.

min_price.description: With shop: lowest price in the shop's currency.

in_stock.description: With shop: only items that can be ordered now.

sort.description: With shop: the order of results; best match first without it.

page.description: With shop: the page of results (limit per page).

limit.description: Results per page, 1 to 25, 10 by default.

tools.name: list_shops
tools.description: Lists shops on nordo with what they sell (categories, number of offers) and where they ship. Optional words narrow it by name or category.

query.description: Words to match a shop name, description or category.

tools.name: get_shop
tools.description: A shop's facts (address, contact, whether it is open for pickup and the next pickup times, shipping regions, delivery time, shipping cost, returns, booking hours, what nordo has verified), its tables and other bookings first (reservations: party sizes, next free times with booking links, how to book for another party size), its public discount codes (listed only where assistants read; anyone may use them) and the code its order links carry, its questions and answers, how one order link holds several items (shipping charged once), its categories and filters, and its offers with item codes and order links. A big catalog comes in pages: page 1 has every category, page 2 and on the rest.

shop.description: The shop's address on nordo, e.g. "acme" (from search_offers or list_shops).

page.description: For a big catalog: the page, 1 by default.

tools.name: get_offer
tools.description: One offer in full: description, photos, every option with its price, stock and order link, its choices (option_groups such as sides or a drink: keys, how many to pick, extra prices, availability), pickup facts for pickup items, and for an appointment, class or table the next free times with booking links (a table's for 2 guests: booking_type, guests).

shop.description: The shop's address on nordo, e.g. "acme" (from search_offers or list_shops).

offer.description: The offer's address within the shop, e.g. "alpine-jacket" (the slug from search_offers or get_shop).

tools.name: get_free_times
tools.description: Every free time of an appointment, class or restaurant table for the next four weeks (or one day), in the shop's time zone, each with its booking link. A table lists only the times with room for the party in guests (2 by default), and each booking link books that many guests; a class lists its places left per time. An appointment with options (a length such as Short hair or Long hair, a ticket type) has its own times per option: name it in option.

shop.description: The shop's address on nordo, e.g. "acme" (from search_offers or list_shops).

offer.description: The offer's address within the shop, e.g. "alpine-jacket" (the slug from search_offers or get_shop).

option.description: Appointments with options: the option key from get_offer, e.g. "long-hair". Each option has its own length and free times.

guests.description: A table: only the times with room for this many guests (2 by default). A class: only the times with this many places left.

tools.name: prepare_order
tools.description: Prepares an order for the person at the live price (for an appointment, holds the time for 15 minutes) and returns a payment link (pay_url) to give them. The person opens it to review and pay with Apple Pay, Google Pay or card; nothing is charged before that, and the link is valid for 30 minutes. Name the exact option (its key from get_offer) or time; an appointment with options takes both, option and time. Without one, the answer lists the choices. A restaurant table takes time and guests (the party size, 2 by default); a time without room for the party answers with the times that have room. Items with required choices (sides, a drink) take them in choices, and pickup items take a pickup time; when one is missing, the answer is the next choice with one link per answer. Several items go in one order with items instead of offer (shipping is charged once per order); each item is {offer, option, choices, qty} or its item code as text, like "alpine-jacket~v:black-m~x2". A discount code goes in code; the answer shows what it took off, or why it was not applied.

shop.description: The shop's address on nordo, e.g. "acme" (from search_offers or list_shops).

offer.description: The offer's address within the shop, e.g. "alpine-jacket" (the slug from search_offers or get_shop). For several items, use items instead.

option.description: The option key from get_offer, e.g. "black-m" or "original". Leave out when the offer has no options.

choices.description: The item's choices (option_groups from get_offer): group key → option keys, e.g. {"sides": ["fries", "coleslaw"], "drink": ["cola"]}. Optional groups can be left out.

pickup.description: Pickup items: "asap", "HH:MM" today or "YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM", in the shop's time zone, within opening hours (get_offer lists the next pickup times).

time.description: Appointments: the time in the shop's time zone, "YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM" (the slot from get_free_times), or "HH:MM" with date.

date.description: Appointments: the day, YYYY-MM-DD, when time is only "HH:MM".

qty.description: How many (or how many places for an appointment). 1 by default.

guests.description: Bookings: the party size. A restaurant table: how many guests (2 by default, up to its guests.max from get_offer). A class: how many places, the same as qty.

code.description: A discount code: one of the shop's public codes listed with the shop (get_shop), or one the person gave.

items.description: Several items in one order, instead of offer, option, choices and qty: e.g. [{"offer": "bucket-8", "option": "original", "choices": {"sides": ["fries", "coleslaw"]}}, {"offer": "garlic-dip", "qty": 2}], or item codes as printed next to each order link: ["alpine-jacket~v:black-m", "merino-beanie~x2"]. Appointments are booked on their own.

offer.description: The offer's address within the shop, e.g. "alpine-jacket" (the slug from search_offers or get_shop).

option.description: The option key from get_offer, e.g. "black-m" or "original". Leave out when the offer has no options.

choices.description: The item's choices (option_groups from get_offer): group key → option keys, e.g. {"sides": ["fries", "coleslaw"], "drink": ["cola"]}. Optional groups can be left out.

qty.description: How many of this item. 1 by default.

tools.name: get_order_status
tools.description: Where a prepared order is: waiting_for_payment, authorized (paid with the amount held until the shop accepts), accepted, paid, ready (for pickup), picked_up, shipped, confirmed (appointment), completed, no_show (the shop marked that nobody came to a free booking), cancelled, declined (nothing charged), refunded or expired. Also every item, for a booking its guests, and for pickup the order number, address and ready time. Uses the order_id returned by prepare_order.
